description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return when paging is used. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 entries are returned on each page.

description.zh:
查询条件，JSON格式的字符串。

>根据不同的查询条件，查询到的防护对象结果不同。详细信息，请参见**Query参数描述**。
description.en:
The query conditions. The value is a JSON string.

> The query results vary based on the query conditions. For more information, see **Query parameter description**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 资源标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The list of resource tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resources --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --query product_:_waf --tag Value=TagValue1 Key=Tagkey1 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeDefenseResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Tag.1.Key Tagkey1 --PageSize 10 --Query 'product_:_waf' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TagValue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
